notes: The page states a canonical extension of γ by the torus G⁰ and gives fibre functors from abelian motives to Q-vector spaces with G-action and to Hodge structures, followed by Φξ. It then states that the G⁰-action and a place of the absolute class field suffice for the Hodge structure. These are reports of the page, without an independent reconstruction of the objects or proof. The lower-case γ is settled by the paired curved forms in the prose and diagram. The tensor formula carries an extra raised loop-and-hook, absent from both witnesses, retained as ∂/d without a mathematical interpretation. Singular “est associé des foncteurs” and “de E” are retained as written. The margin reads “corps de classes absolu”, with absolu underlined. Archive number 160.
